notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token and a Food artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
